decisions.rationale: The seed lists required IDs but does not yet define deterministic actions, inputs, oracles, dependency fingerprints, registry semantics, and closed evidence per ID. That makes the final campaign non-executable. A compact data contract and validator are bounded and materially necessary.
decisions.smallest_fix: Add compact closed per-ID definitions and fingerprint/registry/evidence validation consumed by the existing kit, with representative focused synthetic rejection/success tests.

decisions.rationale: The seed is hash-checked on demand and the worker environment is only returned as data; the actual coding child still inherits ambient process environment. This leaves the required no-endpoint and no-seed-edit boundary unproved. A narrow optional sanitized child environment plus pre/post seed/tree validation and hostile temporary-process tests is proportionate; making the whole target immutable or adding a scheduler is rejected.
decisions.smallest_fix: Add an opt-in allowlisted/sanitized coding-child environment used by C3 target templates, revalidate immutable seed and allowed Git tree at defined admission/result boundaries, and test rewrite/injection/endpoint/expiry/cleanup/contention/resume paths synthetically.

decisions.rationale: Manager triage necessarily follows safe result publication. Wiring future manager evidence into current lane result validation would create a circular dependency and extra lifecycle complexity. The exact hash-bound triage validator is instead invoked at the manager join before any repair or acceptance, as this artifact demonstrates.
